spanish: Y si diere a luz hembra, y se impurecerá dos semanas como su menstruación, y sesenta días y seis días se sentará sobre sangres de purificación.
grammarChanges: Moved 'hembra' to follow 'diere a luz' (word order required by Spanish) so it reads as the object borne, matching h03012005002/h03012005003: qal 3fs תֵלֵד already carries its own subject, and preverbal נְקֵבָה is what is borne, not who bears. No participant or stem force changed; the implicit 3fs subject stays implicit as in the Hebrew.
